problem_type: Published tool metadata is incomplete or independently handwritten instead of owned by executable shared contracts
symptom: 52 fields lack explanations; two existing MCP tools are absent from verb projection; six already-published internal verbs lack offline usecases.
direct_cause: New creative schemas omitted field descriptions, transport metadata was written outside the shared declarations, and the usecase manifest was not extended.
class_root: Tool discovery, input semantics, transport publication and offline coverage do not converge on their actual shared owners.
affected_population: Six existing creative tools and draft_shots transitions
Existing local director render and native batch MCP requests
entry_points: creativeComponentArgumentSchemas / Blender plan schemas / storyboard transition
Existing MCP tools/list and method builders
Agent tool-face usecase CLI and offline fixtures
internal_only_reason: Units, authorization, schema and transport behavior are determined by repository-owned Blender harness, dispatcher and declarations; no external provider or model behavior is changed.
invariants: All published fields retain types, bounds, defaults, enum values and names; descriptions are meaningful English.
MCP tool names, validation shape, method, builder behavior, scope, hints and raw results remain compatible.
Batch requests never approve spending; no new executable permissions or automatic resubmission.
Six real offline scenarios exercise existing semantics and review restrictions; missing/unknown tool names still fail.
No model-face baseline, frozen count, budget ceiling, policy or handler changes.

door_reduction.why_not: Keep existing native schema consumers (canvasTools and creativeToolExecute), storyboard plan generation/subject adaptation/project hydration readers, Director parsers (laneCreativeTools and vibingDirectorAgentProtocol), MCP protocol publication and its independent integrity gates. Each reads or validates a distinct existing surface. Added calls register shared metadata/projections and centralize manifest validation; they do not register new dispatch methods or permissions. Both historical and current maps were generated by door-map, with historical reads from parent git objects.

generality_proof: Shared Zod fields own explanations and unchanged constraints; MCP input/description metadata derives from the same registered verb owners while routing remains unchanged. Complete manifest validation rejects omitted or unknown tools independently of the deliberately preserved frozen count.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own field explanations without widening accepted inputs.
Own metadata for the two already-published MCP operations; handlers and scopes remain existing.
Require exact name coverage and valid offline trajectories without changing count freezes.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Validation-shape fingerprints and unit/action tests preserve the real Blender trust boundary.
Before/after MCP schema fingerprints, methods, annotations, builders and original dispatcher safety tests.
Add six offline scenarios and positive/negative completeness tests; keep the original 21-count frozen assertion unchanged.

recurrence.reason: Every future action, schema field or tool publication can repeat metadata/coverage drift.
same_class_scan: Read actual 52+2 findings and reproduced all 54 locally under bundled Node24.19.
Inspected shared verb assembly, MCP projection and both original method builders/handlers.
Read Blender coordinate conversion, degrees/FOV and camera-path 24fps harness semantics.
Captured validation-only fingerprints for seven existing internal schemas and two MCP schemas before changes.
Read original usecase checker, manifest and its explicit frozen 21-count signature; preserve that count and all freeze owners.
Targets include storyboard schemas, the actual flat plan wire schema, and both new semantic inputs; generated historical 28/current 41 doors with the actual AST mapper and parent git-object reads.

prevention.invariant: Public tool metadata and offline coverage are derived from their actual owners without altering authority or compatibility.
prevention.failure_mode: Unknown/missing tools and invalid input still reject; unauthorized freezes remain visibly red.
prevention.strategy: Complete typed metadata, derive existing MCP surfaces, retain explicit safe routing, and exercise actual offline creative semantics.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove independent MCP schema/description copies and move manifest validation to one tested boundary; do not delete existing tools or frozen guards.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Use existing Zod, shared verb projection and bundled Node24.19 without dependency/version changes.

migration: No project or tool-input migration. Existing names/fields and input validation remain; only metadata ownership, English explanations and offline coverage change.
residual_risks: Model-face freeze and usecase checker's literal 21-count remain unchanged; actual 27 verbs leave both checks red pending approval. No freeze/baseline updates or update-baseline invocation.

MCP payload remains 54562 versus 54083 bytes (+479) after prose compaction. Shared envelope/semantic field descriptions and confirmation/no-auto-resend discipline are retained. Coordinator should free bytes under other MCP owners; no payload baseline or ledger change here.
Canonical set_beat already requires title but its wire schema lacks title. Preserve the existing input set in this metadata batch; hand off the adjacent functional gap instead of changing validation.
